thread.title: Gibraltar Capital Management Inc. Has $12.43 Million Stake in Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL)

author: Jennifer Salazar
title: Gibraltar Capital Management Inc. Has $12.43 Million Stake in Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL)
text:
Posted by Jennifer Salazar on Apr 20th, 2018 // No Comments 
Gibraltar Capital Management Inc. boosted its holdings in Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 2.0% during the fourth quarter, according to its most recent Form 13F filing with the SEC. The fund owned 73,459 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after acquiring an additional 1,431 shares during the period. Apple accounts for about 9.9% of Gibraltar Capital Management Inc.’s portfolio, making the stock its largest holding. Gibraltar Capital Management Inc.’s holdings in Apple were worth $12,431,000 at the end of the most recent quarter. 
A number of other institutional investors and hedge funds have also added to or reduced their stakes in AAPL. Vantage Financial Partners Ltd. Inc. acquired a new position in shares of Apple during the second quarter worth $400,000. FNY Managed Accounts LLC boosted its stake in Apple by 852.4% in the second quarter. FNY Managed Accounts LLC now owns 800 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $115,000 after acquiring an additional 716 shares in the last quarter. Oak Point Wealth Management acquired a new position in Apple in the fourth quarter valued at $163,000. Crow Point Partners LLC boosted its stake in Apple by 100.0% in the third quarter. Crow Point Partners LLC now owns 1,000 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $153,000 after acquiring an additional 500 shares in the last quarter. Finally, Home Federal Bank of Tennessee acquired a new position in Apple in the fourth quarter valued at $217,000. Hedge funds and other institutional investors own 61.35% of the company’s stock. 
In related news, insider Luca Maestri sold 39,122 shares of the company’s stock in a transaction on Friday, April 13th. The shares were sold at an average price of $174.66, for a total transaction of $6,833,048.52. Following the completion of the transaction, the insider now directly owns 64,475 shares in the company, valued at approximately $11,261,203.50. The transaction was disclosed in a filing with the SEC, which is available through the SEC website . Also, insider Philip W. Schiller sold 69,491 shares of the company’s stock in a transaction on Tuesday, April 3rd. The shares were sold at an average price of $166.42, for a total transaction of $11,564,692.22. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . Over the last quarter, insiders have sold 125,988 shares of company stock valued at $21,336,201. Corporate insiders own 0.08% of the company’s stock. 
Several brokerages have recently weighed in on AAPL. Nomura set a $175.00 target price on shares of Apple and gave the stock a “neutral” rating in a research note on Tuesday, April 3rd. Vetr cut shares of Apple from a “strong-buy” rating to a “buy” rating and set a $186.86 price target for the company. in a report on Monday, April 2nd. BMO Capital Markets cut shares of Apple from an “outperform” rating to a “market perform” rating and increased their target price for the company from $162.00 to $166.00 in a report on Wednesday, January 31st. Royal Bank of Canada set a $203.00 price objective on shares of Apple and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a research note on Tuesday, April 3rd. Finally, Morningstar set a $170.00 price objective on shares of Apple and gave the stock a “neutral” rating in a research note on Friday, February 2nd. Two analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, seventeen have given a hold rating, thirty-two have given a buy rating and one has given a strong buy rating to the company’s stock. The company presently has an average rating of “Buy” and a consensus target price of $203.21. 
NASDAQ:AAPL opened at $172.80 on Friday. The firm has a market cap of $904,392.13, a P/E ratio of 18.76, a P/E/G ratio of 1.35 and a beta of 1.25. Apple has a one year low of $141.16 and a one year high of $183.50. The company has a quick ratio of 1.20, a current ratio of 1.24 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.74. 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last released its earnings results on Thursday, February 1st. The iPhone maker reported $3.89 EPS for the quarter, beating the Thomson Reuters’ consensus estimate of $3.82 by $0.07. The firm had revenue of $88.29 billion during the quarter, compared to analysts’ expectations of $87.62 billion. Apple had a net margin of 21.13% and a return on equity of 37.37%. The business’s quarterly revenue was up 12.7% compared to the same quarter last year. During the same period in the prior year, the company earned $3.36 EPS. analysts forecast that Apple will post 11.37 earnings per share for the current fiscal year. Apple Profile 
Apple Inc (Apple) designs, manufactures and markets mobile communication and media devices, personal computers, and portable digital music players, and a variety of related software, services, peripherals, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications. The Company’s products and services include iPhone, iPad, Mac, iPod, Apple TV, a portfolio of consumer and professional software applications, the iOS and OS X operating systems, iCloud, and a variety of accessory, service and support offerings.
